resumeText:
DANIEL FORSYTHE
Email: daniel.forsythe@example.com | Phone: 0400 000 000
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/danielforsythe

SUMMARY
Recent Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience automating build pipelines and deploying containerised applications during university projects. Comfortable working in Linux environments and keen to grow into a Graduate DevOps Engineer role, applying scripting and CI/CD skills to real production systems.

SKILLS
Python, Bash, Git, Linux, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Docker, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, SQL

EXPERIENCE
IT Support Assistant (Part-time) — Coastline University IT Services
02/2022 - 11/2023
Supported staff and students with hardware and software issues across campus computer labs.
- Responsible for logging support tickets and escalating hardware faults to senior technicians.
- Assisted with imaging new lab computers and installing standard software packages.
- Attended weekly team meetings to review outstanding tickets.

Casual Retail Assistant — Northfield Hardware
06/2021 - 01/2022
- Handled customer enquiries and processed sales transactions at the front counter.
- Restocked shelves and maintained store presentation standards.

PROJECTS
Automated Build Pipeline for Student Grading Tool
03/2023 - 06/2023
- Built a GitHub Actions pipeline that ran unit tests and linting on every pull request for a Python grading script used by a small tutoring group.
- Wrote a Bash script to package the tool and generate release notes automatically, replacing a manual process that previously took about 20 minutes per release.

Personal Budget Tracker
08/2022 - 11/2022
- Developed a command-line budgeting application in Python with SQL storage, allowing users to catagorise expenses and view monthly summaries.
- Lead the design of the database schema and later refactored it after realising the original version couldn't handle recurring transactions.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Computer Science
Coastline University
02/2020 - 11/2023
- Relevant coursework: Operating Systems, Networked Systems, Software Engineering Practice, Databases.
- Capstone project: automated testing framework for a peer's mobile app (grade: High Distinction).

REFERENCES
Available on request.
